description:
The Experimental Novel: all novelistic writings of the POST-ARCHIVAL art-research practice.

Home of The Revolt of Fiction — a trilogy (The History-Project, The Archives-Project, The Chronotopium: A Story of Algorithmogenesis) — plus the illuminated bibliography (REFMATS), the series bible, the Interzone staging buffer, the novel logs, and the text-engine: Python programs for textual experimentation.
title: The Experimental Novel
